integrity_and_limitations: The result applies to ambient intrinsic geodesic distances of independent arclength-uniform boundary points on the canonical flat rectangular Möbius quotient. It does not cover embedded extrinsic distances, curved metrics, interior point sampling, or arbitrary Riemannian surfaces. A closed-form proof and a standalone consistency-checker are included. Priority relative to unindexed literature has not been independently established.
title: A width-invisibility transition in boundary-distance statistics of flat Möbius bands
